_comment: Marketing posts over time — feeds the 'Marketing Posts' chart in the Dev Console (ConsoleOverview), rendered next to Webapp Serves for traffic correlation. HYBRID source: entries with source='postiz' are REGENERATED by `npm run sync:marketing` (pulls the automated channels from self-hosted Postiz); entries with source='manual' are hand-edited and PRESERVED across syncs. To log a manual post (X / Reddit / TikTok / Patreon), append an object to `posts` with the date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC), platform, source='manual', and an optional note.
